Job Description / Roles & Responsibilities (in Detail)
Job Title: Gen AI/Agentic AI Engineer
Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Gen AI/Agentic candidate will have a strong background in agent development using Python,experience in vector databases, and applied AI using large language models RAG, and other Generative AI applications. This role requires a blend of advance structures, and coding, coupled with a passion for AI-driven innovation.


Key Responsibilities:


• Design, develop, and maintain robust agentic systems integrating advanced AI and ML capabilities.

• Develop agents using the agentic frameworks in python. Experience in langgraph or autogen is mandatory

• Implement and optimize LangChain for efficient language model chaining and application.

• Experience in MCP and A2A is required

• Develop and deploy solutions based on Agent, LLMs, RAG to solve complex problems and improve user interactions.

•Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define clear specifications, deliverables, and timelines.

• Get the overall solution deployed in customer network and provide support
